workflow_runs.name: Attempt original Windows Phone emulator setup
workflow_runs.display_title: Improve Metro shell, hubs and SDK [verify-ui] (#6)

head_commit.message:
Improve Metro shell, hubs and SDK [verify-ui] (#6)

Pair Start/Apps paging with bounded capture lifetime; restore capture ownership after document replacement; unify Action Center chronology and current-authority dismissal; add native phone progress and route-aware SDK pivots; retain Settings and Office panes with separate search.

Candidate d515348 passed all seven browser, desktop and mobile gates. Browser verification passed 469 Rust tests (one ignored), 80 JavaScript tests and 112 rendered checks with 198 captures. Preserve existing verification gates and run full rendered verification again for publication.
